<div class="col-lg-6" id="txtPostalCodeDiv" style="display: none;">
<label>Postal Code <span class="text-danger"></span></label>
<input class="form-control" id="txtPostalCode" maxlength="7" name="txtPostalCode" placeholder="Enter Postal Code" required="required" style="display: none" type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-6">
<label>Weight (KG.) <span class="text-danger"></span></label>
<span class="text-danger" id="RequiredFieldValidator5" style="visibility:hidden;">*</span>
<span class="text-danger" id="RegularExpressionValidator1" style="visibility:hidden;">*</span>
<input class="form-control wtt" id="txtWeight" name="txtWeight" type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-6">
<label>Date <span class="text-danger"></span></label>
<span class="text-danger" id="RequiredFieldValidator6" style="visibility:hidden;">*</span>

<script>
            var slideIndex = 1;
            showSlides(slideIndex);

            function plusSlides(n) {
                showSlides(slideIndex += n);
            }

            function currentSlide(n) {
                showSlides(slideIndex = n);
            }

            function showSlides(n) {
                var i;
                var slides = document.getElementsByClassName("mySlides");
                var dots = document.getElementsByClassName("dot");
                if (n > slides.length) { slideIndex = 1 }
                if (n < 1) { slideIndex = slides.length }

                for (i = 0; i < slides.length; i++) {
                    slides[i].style.display = "none";
                }
                for (i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
                    dots[i].className = dots[i].className.replace(" active", "");
                }
                slides[slideIndex - 1].style.display = "block";
                dots[slideIndex - 1].className += " active";
            }

            var autoslideIndex = 0;
            carousel();

            function carousel() {
                var i;
                var x = document.getElementsByClassName("mySlides");
                for (i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
                    x[i].style.display = "none";
                }
                autoslideIndex++;
                if (autoslideIndex > x.length) { autoslideIndex = 1 }
                x[autoslideIndex - 1].style.display = "block";
                setTimeout(carousel, 4000);
            }

        </script>

            if ($("#subscribe_to_email3").val() == "") {

            $.ajax({

                success: function (data) {

                        $('#email_name3').hide();
                        $('#subscribe_to_email3').hide();
                        $('#Buttonsubscribe3').hide();
                        $('#sub_result3').html("<font color='red'>Thank you for subscribing with us. We’ll let you know about our special offers & upcoming events.</font>");

                        setTimeout(function () {

                        }, 2000);
                        $("#submitfrm3")[0].reset();

                        return false;
                    } else if (data == 3) {

            return $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: _url,
                data: _data,
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                beforeSend: function () {
                    // uiBlock();
                },
                success: _onsuccess,

                    }

        function onORGclick() {

            if ($('#ddlOrgns option').length > 1) { return; }

            var myurl = 'IndexNEW.aspx/OrignDDL';
            var mydata = new Object();
            XHRPOSTRequest(myurl, mydata, function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    $("#ddlOrgns").empty();
                    var select = $("#ddlOrgns");
                    var option = $("<option value >Please Select</option>");
                    select.append($(option));
                    debugger;
                    var obj = jQuery.parseJSON(result.d);
                    for (var a = 0; a < obj.stations.length; a++) {
                        var val = obj.stations[a];
                        var option = $("<option value=" + val.stationId + ">" + val.description + "</option>");
                        select.append($(option));
                    }

                }
                else
                    showNotification("Something Went Wrong", "error");

            });

            var myurl = 'IndexNEW.aspx/DestDDL';
            var mydata = new Object();
            XHRPOSTRequest(myurl, mydata, function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    $("#ddlDest").empty();
                    var select = $("#ddlDest");
                    var option = $("<option value >Please Select</option>");
                    select.append($(option));
                    debugger;
                    var obj = jQuery.parseJSON(result.d);
                    for (var a = 0; a < obj.stations.length; a++) {
                        var val = obj.stations[a];
                        var option = $("<option value=" + val.stationId + "-" + val.countryCode + ">" + val.description + "</option>");
                        select.append($(option));
                    }
                }
                else
                    showNotification("Something Went Wrong", "error");

            });

            $("#ddlOrgns").hover();


        }

        function onDDclick() {

            if ($('#ddlDest option').length > 1) { return; }

            var myurl = 'IndexNEW.aspx/DestDDL';
            var mydata = new Object();
            XHRPOSTRequest(myurl, mydata, function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    //$("#LeadFormID").empty();
                    var select = $("#ddlDest");
                    var option = $("<option value >Please Select</option>");
                    select.append($(option));
                    debugger;
                    var obj = jQuery.parseJSON(result.d);
                    for (var a = 0; a < obj.stations.length; a++) {
                        var val = obj.stations[a];
                        var option = $("<option value=" + val.stationId + ">" + val.description + "</option>");
                        select.append($(option));
                    }
                }
                else
                    showNotification("Something Went Wrong", "error");

            });
        }


        function NotAllowHTMLTagsEvents() {
            $('input[type=text]').add($('textarea')).add($('input[type=password]')).bind('keyup keypress keydown blur change', function (e) {
                if ($(this).val().includes('<') || $(this).val().includes('>')) {
                    // ShowPopupMessage('This character is not allowed.', 2)
                    e.preventDefault();
                    $(this).val('');
                }

            })
        }

    </script>
